paragraphs.text: Progressive tool discovery for DeepSeek Harness PTC using the official scoped registry
# PTC Tool Search
English | 中文
Load PTC tool definitions on demand while preserving conversation history. Across 12 live four-turn
sessions, the plugin reduced mean cumulative conversation input by **51.46% (GPT)** and **50.00% (Mu
se)**. Output tokens and latency are reported alongside the reductions.
An independent community Host bundle using the official DeepSeek Harness scoped tool registry. Versi
on 0.1.1 supports **Harness 0.2.1-rc.2** and Node.js 24+.
## Repeated live results
Measured on 2026-10-18: macOS ARM64, Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2, CLIProxyAPI Responses. **3 runs per model p
er group: 12 new sessions, 48 turns and 12 real image generations.** Identical four-turn prompts cov
er JSON reading, terminal execution, result writing, tool-free recall, image generation and file rea
dback. A uses the full PTC SDK; B enables this plugin. Values below are means per complete four-turn
uses the full PTC SDK; B enables this plugin. Values below are means per complete four-turn session.
| Model | Input tokens A → B | Input reduction | Output tokens A → B | Active seconds A → B | Workfl
Uncached input increased: GPT 6.1 Sol: 23,521.0 → 31,405.7 (+33.52%); Muse Spark 1.3: 25,761.0 → 31,
464.0 (+22.14%). These results do not establish billing savings.
Input includes cache reads/writes, searches and retries. Output counts conversation-model tokens; th
e image service does not expose its own token usage. Active time includes tools and image generation
, excluding gaps between user prompts. **Actual charges: not reported**, never treated as zero; no b
illing reduction is claimed.
The initial SDK shrank from **35 definitions to 2**; mean first-request input fell **80.27–80.79%**.
Both groups expose only `run_code` at the API level. Discovery adds round trips: mean model request
s were GPT 6.1 Sol: 7.0 → 11.7; Muse Spark 1.3: 8.0 → 12.0. Output and latency need not decrease, an
d the SDK grows as tools accumulate. GPT had no tool errors; Muse A/B had 4/3 recoverable errors res
pectively, all retried to completion and included.
**Image dimensions:** every call requested `1024x1024`, returned GPT 6.1 Sol: 1254×1254 (n=6); Muse
Spark 1.3: 1536×1024 (n=6); exact size matches: **0/12**. Workflow success covers tool execution, ar
ithmetic, recall and image artifacts, not requested-size compliance. Compare A/B within each model,
not image speed across models.
This is a small repeated sample of one fixed workflow. See the per-run report, method and limitation
s and auditable data for means, medians and ranges.
## Install
Use Harness **Plugins → Add plugin**, then enter `github:hrygo/dsh-ptc-tool-search#v0.1.1`, or use t
ugins → Add plugin**, then enter `github:hrygo/dsh-ptc-tool-search#v0.1.1`, or use the official CLI:

For an immutable installation, replace `v0.1.1` with the full commit SHA in the release notes. The r
elease also provides a tarball and SHA-256 checksum. Download and verify them, then install with `ds
h plugin --profile desktop add ./hrygo-dsh-ptc-tool-search-0.1.1.tgz`.
This package ships executable ESM JavaScript: no compilation, dependencies, `prepare` script or buil
d-script permission is needed. Restart Desktop after replacing an installed version, then create a P
TC session. Remove a previous local development installation first; only one `tool_search` plugin ma
emove a previous local development installation first; only one `tool_search` plugin may be enabled.

## Use
New PTC agents initially see `tools.tool_search` plus agent-owned tools. Inside `run_code`:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
End that `run_code`. On the next model request Harness regenerates the SDK with the selected tool; c
all `tools.bash` in another `run_code`. Print or return the search result once. Prefer exact callabl
e names and `limit:1`; short English capability keywords also work. Search uses deterministic lexica
l matching, without network calls or embeddings.
Selections accumulate for each live agent. Recreated agents, including after restart or resume, disc
over again. Existing live agents at installation retain their previous surface. Tools registered aft
er agent creation need a new agent to enter its catalog. Standard/native mode is unaffected. Other p
olicy restrictions remain enforced; discovery cannot grant an excluded capability.
## Configuration and rollback
The bundle inserts row `ptc-tool-search`. Configure it through Harness plugin configuration:
| Key | Default | Meaning |

| `enabled` | `true` | Enable discovery for new PTC agents. |
| `maxResults` | `3` | Maximum results

accepted by a search call; positive integer. |
| `maxQueryChars` | `256` | Maximum query length; po

sitive integer. |
| `maxDescriptionChars` | `160` | Search result description length; positive integ

e integer. |
| `maxDescriptionChars` | `160` | Search result description length; positive integer. |
The selected SDK retains full tool definitions. Search adds a model round trip; broad queries can lo
ad unnecessary definitions. As tools are selected, the SDK grows.
Disable or uninstall **PTC Tool Search** in Plugin Manager and create a new PTC session to restore f
ull SDK visibility. No app or proxy changes are required.
## Verification

Nine tests cover ranking, bounds, scope isolation, policy intersection, unload and recreation. Local
macOS ARM64 acceptance on 2026-10-18 verified GPT 6.1 Sol and Muse Spark 1.3 over CLIProxyAPI Respo
nses, including terminal calls, follow-up memory and image generation. See acceptance details, inclu
ding image attachment and file checks.
No runtime dependencies, credential handling, install scripts, prompt rewriting or custom persistent
session events are added. Harness owns SDK generation, guarded tool dispatch, approvals and logging
session events are added. Harness owns SDK generation, guarded tool dispatch, approvals and logging.
